# A write the waiting part of a fetch makes lands on the page, and rekeys
# what the page keys on it, on every target. The fetch runs on a goroutine on
# the Go targets: bubbletea's reads a snapshot of the Model, so `mon = "b"`
# wrote the copy, which nothing showed and nothing rekeyed, and fyne and gtk4
# wrote the Model off the thread that draws it. Each such write is now posted
# back to the loop (passOffLoopWrites), a call mutating it, `seen.push(k)`,
# as an assignment is. The request is bound to a local
# nothing reads, which Go refuses to declare until passUnreadLocals makes it
# the call -- a request's intrinsic among the calls it does.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import async "sngl:async"
import http "sngl:http"
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

func answer(r http.Request) option[http.Response] {
    return http.Response{status=200, headers={}, body=r.url}
}

component page ui.node {
    var mon = "a"
    var got option[string] = null
    var shape option[string] = null
    var seen list[string] = []

    async.query(
        on = "k",
        fetch = func(k string, life async.Lifetime) async.Result[string] {
            var r = http.get("http://dex/{k}")
            mon = "b"
            seen.push(k)
            return {ok=k}
        },
        :value = got,
    )
    async.query(
        on = mon,
        fetch = func(m string, life async.Lifetime) async.Result[string] {
            return {ok="form of {m}"}
        },
        :value = shape,
    )
    ui.text(mon)
}

// A write the waiting part of a fetch makes lands on the page, and moves
// what the page keys on it.
func testAWaitingWriteLands(t test.Test, c page) {
    t.setContext(http.answer, answer)
    t.wait(func() => c.got != null, 2000)
    t.wait(func() => c.shape == "form of b", 2000)
    t.assert(c.mon == "b")
    t.assert(c.seen == ["k"])
}

ui.window {
    page()
}
